6ea183bec5.why: The odd-one-out tell is fixed: the choices now name the first, the second and neither. 'The second, for cuttings keep each species unchanged' is wrong (clones hold little genetic variety). The strong lure, 'same 20 species', stays live. The clarity fix ('the same number of plants') reads well. Three levels of biodiversity and cuttings as clones are sourced. The T2 Gros Michel and T3 runner facts are premises only.

31f9d2930c.why: Context fix verified. The 2017 work is an ESA meeting abstract. Isbell's team pooled 46 diversity-manipulation experiments and found diversity raised resistance to wet and dry extremes (about 50 against 25 percent change) with 'no detectable dependence of ecosystem resilience on biodiversity', so 'recovered no faster' is true. The idea no longer looks overturned. The key is unchanged and sourced. The T1 'many kinds' fact is only setting.

4721b8b5f3.why: The logic tell is fixed: the stem gives only the steadier totals. Tilman 1996 (207 plots, 11 years): total biomass variability was significantly lower in rich plots, while species abundances were 'not stabilized' by richness, and compensatory increases 'cause species abundances to be more variable'. The paper supports May's prediction for populations. So the key is right and 'less', 'about as much' and 'in step' are wrong.

11d036fe0d.why: The tell clause 'that blast seldom harms' is cut, so the key now needs the dilution idea. The root-poison choice is not among the mixture mechanisms studied (dilution, barrier, induced resistance) and is implausible for a leaf disease. 'What helped' allows for the drier-leaf mechanism, which no choice offers. Zhu 2005's 35-40 cm and the drier leaves match. The resistance-genes sentence is now accurate.

3678fdc549.why: 'The same genes and the same weakness' keeps the clonal point and leaves the seedling and Irish-variety choices live. The key 'In wild relatives of the potato' drops the country (lane fix), and R1-R11 from Solanum demissum of Mexico is sourced. The Irish varieties of 1845 lacked resistance, and spraying does not change genes. The T2 Gros Michel fact is premise only.

b4eaa9de8a.why: The false 'two inbred parent lines' clause is gone (double crosses were still common in 1970), and 'many named hybrids' makes the Gros Michel lure live. The key is now of equal length. Dropping 'new' keeps 'building up for decades' live, and the card's 'a year or two before' covers the 1968/1969 split. T-cms in about 85-90 percent of hybrids and the roughly 15 percent loss are sourced.

7ee723d067.why: Hubbard Brook W2: all woody vegetation cut 18 November to 31 December 1965, herbicide 1966-68, streamflow up 40, 28 and 26 percent, nitrate from under 1 to over 50 mg/L. Likens et al. 1970 give 41-fold and 56-fold concentrations, almost continuously above drinking-water limits. The key is true, and the 2x2 needs both halves. It does not re-ask the T3 marsh-as-sponge flood question (that is flood peaks from drained land, this is lost transpiration and nitrate uptake), the T2 caring-for-water keys (chlorine, sewage air, oil runoff, terraces, straw, windbreaks) or the T1 roots-hold-soil key. Optional precision: 'carried 41 times the nitrate' is a concentration, so 'its water held 41 times the nitrate' would be exact.
